# Clean Yield — full reference

Updated 2026-11-11. Prices are for the Apify Free plan unless stated; "today" is the price charged now and "from November 24, 2026" is a scheduled change announced with Apify's 14-day notice.

## Company Enrichment from Website

Store page: https://apify.com/cleanyield/company-enrichment-from-website
Try the Lite version first (no per-result charge): https://apify.com/cleanyield/company-enrichment-from-website-lite
API actor ID: cleanyield/company-enrichment-from-website

Turns a list of company websites or domains, or a Google Maps export pasted as it is, into one row per company with contact emails, phone numbers and address when the site publishes them, LinkedIn and social profiles, the tech stack the site runs on and hiring signals. It reads only public pages of each company’s own site and respects robots.txt.

Input: domains (or full website URLs), or rows / csvUrl / datasetId with a Google Maps export; optional sections, maxPagesPerDomain, includePersonalEmails.

Output (one row per company):
- companyName, description, country, language: who the company is
- emails: generic and role inboxes (info@, sales@, press@) with the page where each was found; personal emails are left out by default
- phones, primaryPhone: phone numbers in E.164 format, when the site publishes them
- address: postal address, when the site publishes it
- socialProfiles: LinkedIn, X, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, GitHub and more, when linked from the site
- technologies: tech stack detected on the site (CMS, analytics, CRM and marketing tools, frameworks, CDN)
- hiring: careers page, the hiring system it uses and the open roles count when the job board is public

Price today: USD 10 per 1,000 companies (USD 0.01 per company returned) on the Apify Free plan; Apify subscribers pay less (Gold: USD 7 per 1,000).
From November 24, 2026: The Gold tier moves to USD 7.50 per 1,000, and monitor mode adds USD 0.005 per watched company per monitor run (today monitor mode charges only new or changed companies).
Optional Pro mode: + USD 0.02 per company (buying intent score, size, fit, why now). Sites that are down, parked or blocked are not charged.
Lite version: no per-result charge, up to 25 companies per run (only Apify platform usage applies).

Real example (run on Apify on 2026-11-09, 3 results; cafetortoni.com.ar did not respond during this run and returned no row (failed sites are not charged).)

Input:
```json
{
  "domains": [
    "totvs.com",
    "cafetortoni.com.ar",
    "liverpool.com.mx",
    "vercel.com"
  ]
}
```

Output (selected fields):
```json
[
  {
    "domain": "totvs.com",
    "companyName": "TOTVS",
    "country": "BR",
    "primaryEmail": "sp.cloud.csirt@totvs.com.br",
    "primaryPhone": "+558007098100",
    "socialProfiles": {
      "linkedin": "https://www.linkedin.com/company/totvs",
      "x": "https://x.com/totvs",
      "facebook": "https://www.facebook.com/totvs",
      "instagram": "https://www.instagram.com/totvs",
      "youtube": "https://www.youtube.com/totvs"
    },
    "technologies": [
      "WordPress",
      "HubSpot",
      "RD Station",
      "Google Tag Manager",
      "Microsoft Clarity",
      "Meta Pixel",
      "jQuery",
      "Cloudflare"
    ],
    "hiring": {
      "isHiring": true,
      "careersUrl": "https://www.totvs.com/trabalhe-conosco/",
      "atsProvider": null,
      "openRolesCount": null
    },
    "scrapedAt": "2026-11-09T22:19:10.492Z"
  }
]
```

API call:
```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/cleanyield~company-enrichment-from-website/run-sync-get-dataset-items?maxTotalChargeUsd=1" -H "Authorization: Bearer $APIFY_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"domains":["totvs.com","cafetortoni.com.ar","liverpool.com.mx","vercel.com"]}'
```

Use-case pages: https://cleanyield-data.github.io/company-enrichment-api/, https://cleanyield-data.github.io/find-company-emails-from-website/, https://cleanyield-data.github.io/google-maps-leads-enrichment/

## ATS Jobs Scraper

Store page: https://apify.com/cleanyield/ats-jobs-scraper
Try the Lite version first (no per-result charge): https://apify.com/cleanyield/ats-jobs-scraper-lite
API actor ID: cleanyield/ats-jobs-scraper

Returns the live open jobs of any company straight from its own careers page on 19 hiring systems (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workday, Oracle Recruiting Cloud, Eightfold, Phenom, SuccessFactors, iCIMS, Recruitee, Personio, Teamtailor and more), in one format, with no expired listings. Measured on 2026-11-11 on a sample of 286 companies (Fortune 500, scale-ups, healthcare, industry and retail in the US, Europe and Latin America), it reads the jobs of 71.7% of them (205) from their website alone.

Input: companies (names, board tokens or careers page URLs); optional keywords, locations, workplaceTypes, postedWithinDays, maxJobsPerCompany.

Output (one row per job):
- title, department, company: the job and who is hiring
- location, city, countryCode, workplaceType: where, and whether it is remote, hybrid or onsite
- employmentType: full-time, part-time, contract or internship, when the posting states it
- salaryAnnualMin, salaryAnnualMax, salaryCurrency, salaryText: salary range when the company posts one (roughly half of jobs, depending on the company)
- postedAt, url, applyUrl: posting date and direct links to the job and the application form
- descriptionText / descriptionHtml: full job description, optional

Price today: USD 2 per 1,000 jobs (USD 0.002 per job) plus USD 0.005 per run, on the Apify Free plan; Silver and Gold subscribers pay USD 1.20 per 1,000.
From November 24, 2026: USD 5 per 1,000 jobs (USD 0.005 per job) plus USD 0.005 per run; Silver and Gold USD 3 per 1,000.
Optional: monitor mode USD 0.004 per company checked, Pro mode + USD 0.005 per job, company details + USD 0.01 per company. Companies not found and failed requests are not charged.
Lite version: no per-result charge, up to 25 jobs per run (only Apify platform usage applies).

Real example (run on Apify on 2026-11-09, 10 results; 6 of the 10 jobs in this run include a salary range; the rest leave salary fields empty because the posting has none.)

Input:
```json
{
  "companies": [
    "anthropic"
  ],
  "maxJobsPerCompany": 10,
  "includeDescription": "none"
}
```

Output (selected fields):
```json
[
  {
    "jobId": "greenhouse:anthropic:5476704008",
    "ats": "greenhouse",
    "company": "Anthropic",
    "title": "Recruiter, Communications",
    "department": "People",
    "location": "San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY",
    "countryCode": "US",
    "workplaceType": "onsite",
    "employmentType": null,
    "salaryAnnualMin": 240000,
    "salaryAnnualMax": 295000,
    "salaryCurrency": "USD",
    "salaryText": "Annual Salary: USD 240,000–295,000",
    "postedAt": "2026-11-09T14:22:17.000Z",
    "applyUrl": "https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/anthropic/jobs/5476704008"
  },
  {
    "jobId": "greenhouse:anthropic:5476577008",
    "ats": "greenhouse",
    "company": "Anthropic",
    "title": "Applied AI Architect",
    "department": "Applied AI",
    "location": "Seoul, South Korea",
    "countryCode": "KR",
    "workplaceType": "onsite",
    "employmentType": null,
    "salaryAnnualMin": null,
    "salaryAnnualMax": null,
    "salaryCurrency": null,
    "salaryText": null,
    "postedAt": "2026-11-09T06:47:38.000Z",
    "applyUrl": "https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/anthropic/jobs/5476577008"
  }
]
```

API call:
```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/cleanyield~ats-jobs-scraper/run-sync-get-dataset-items?maxTotalChargeUsd=1" -H "Authorization: Bearer $APIFY_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"companies":["anthropic"],"maxJobsPerCompany":10,"includeDescription":"none"}'
```

Use-case pages: https://cleanyield-data.github.io/greenhouse-jobs-api/, https://cleanyield-data.github.io/workday-jobs-scraper/, https://cleanyield-data.github.io/job-postings-data-api/

## FMCSA Carrier Lookup

Store page: https://apify.com/cleanyield/fmcsa-carrier-data
Try the Lite version first (no per-result charge): https://apify.com/cleanyield/fmcsa-carrier-data-lite
API actor ID: cleanyield/fmcsa-carrier-data

Looks up US trucking companies by USDOT or MC number, or lists carriers by state, city, ZIP code or radius, including the ones that registered in the last days, from official FMCSA data; statuses that may be out of date in the open data are re-checked live on SAFER.

Input: dotNumbers or mcNumbers; or states, cities, zipCodes, nearLocation + radiusMiles, addedWithinDays, entityTypes.

Output (one row per carrier):
- dotNumber, mcNumbers, legalName, companyName: who the carrier is
- usdotStatus, authorityStatus, authority: USDOT status and each operating authority with its status and dates
- insurancePolicies, insuranceSummary: insurer, coverage and effective dates on file
- safety, safetyRating, outOfService: inspections, crashes, out-of-service rates and safety rating
- powerUnits, drivers, cargoCarried, physicalAddress: fleet size, cargo and address
- phone, email: phone, and email when on file with FMCSA
- leadScore, leadTier: a 0–100 lead score with the reasons behind it

Price today: USD 5 per 1,000 carriers (USD 0.005 per carrier) on the Apify Free plan; Apify subscribers pay less (Gold: USD 3.50 per 1,000).
From November 24, 2026: Monitor mode adds USD 0.001 per watched carrier per monitor run (today monitor mode charges only new or changed carriers). The price per carrier does not change.
Optional: Pro mode + USD 0.005 per carrier, company website contacts + USD 0.01 per website read. Numbers that do not exist and incomplete records are not charged.
Lite version: no per-result charge, up to 25 carriers per run (only Apify platform usage applies).

Real example (run on Apify on 2026-11-09, 3 results; Shortened: the full record also has email when on file, fleet equipment, inspections, crashes, authority history and more. The email on file is omitted on this page.)

Input:
```json
{
  "dotNumbers": [
    "80806",
    "53467",
    "264184"
  ]
}
```

Output (selected fields):
```json
[
  {
    "dotNumber": "80806",
    "mcNumbers": [
      "MC-135797"
    ],
    "legalName": "J B HUNT TRANSPORT INC",
    "companyName": "J B Hunt",
    "usdotStatus": "active",
    "authorityStatus": "active",
    "carrierOperation": "interstate",
    "powerUnits": 25280,
    "drivers": 24116,
    "physicalAddress": {
      "city": "LOWELL",
      "state": "AR",
      "oneLine": "615 J B HUNT CORPORATE DRIVE, LOWELL, AR 72745, US"
    },
    "phone": "+14798200000",
    "safetyRating": "satisfactory",
    "insurancePolicies": [
      {
        "insuranceType": "bipd",
        "layer": "excess",
        "insurer": "Ace American Insurance Company",
        "coverageUsd": 2500000,
        "effectiveDate": "2025-12-31"
      },
      {
        "insuranceType": "cargo",
        "layer": "primary",
        "insurer": "Travelers Casualty and Surety Company of America",
        "coverageUsd": 5000,
        "effectiveDate": "2023-10-23"
      }
    ],
    "leadScore": 38,
    "leadTier": "cold",
    "scrapedAt": "2026-11-09T22:19:06.115Z"
  }
]
```

API call:
```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/cleanyield~fmcsa-carrier-data/run-sync-get-dataset-items?maxTotalChargeUsd=1" -H "Authorization: Bearer $APIFY_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"dotNumbers":["80806","53467","264184"]}'
```

Use-case pages: https://cleanyield-data.github.io/fmcsa-carrier-lookup-api/

## App Store & Google Play Reviews Scraper

Store page: https://apify.com/cleanyield/app-store-google-play-reviews
Try the Lite version first (no per-result charge): https://apify.com/cleanyield/app-store-google-play-reviews-lite
API actor ID: cleanyield/app-store-google-play-reviews

Returns the reviews of any iPhone (App Store) or Android (Google Play) app in one format, for any country and language, with filters by rating, date and keyword.

Input: apps (App Store or Google Play links or IDs); optional countries, languages, maxReviewsPerApp, minRating, maxRating, reviewsSince, keywords.

Output (one row per review):
- store, appName, appId: which store and app
- rating, title, text: stars, review title (App Store) and review text
- date, appVersion: when it was written and the app version reviewed, when the store shows it
- country, language: the storefront country or review language you asked for
- developerReply: the developer reply with its date (Google Play)
- url, thumbsUp: link to the review and helpful votes

Price today: USD 0.10 per 1,000 reviews (10,000 reviews = USD 1) on the Apify Free plan; subscribers pay slightly less.
From November 24, 2026: Monitor mode checks cost USD 0.01 per app per monitor run (USD 0.005 today). The price per review does not change.
Optional: alerts add-on USD 0.01 per app with enough data, Pro mode + USD 2 per 1,000 reviews. Failed or incomplete reviews are not charged.
Lite version: no per-result charge, up to 25 reviews per run (only Apify platform usage applies).

Real example (run on Apify on 2026-11-09, 30 results; 30 reviews returned, all 1–2 stars as requested.)

Input:
```json
{
  "apps": [
    "https://apps.apple.com/us/app/netflix/id363590051"
  ],
  "countries": [
    "us"
  ],
  "maxRating": 2,
  "maxReviewsPerApp": 30
}
```

Output (selected fields):
```json
[
  {
    "store": "appstore",
    "appName": "Netflix",
    "country": "US",
    "language": null,
    "rating": 2,
    "title": "Too many ads",
    "text": "I pay for the app. I should not have to watch ads.",
    "date": "2026-11-08T15:01:58.000Z",
    "appVersion": "26.4.0",
    "developerReply": null
  },
  {
    "store": "appstore",
    "appName": "Netflix",
    "country": "US",
    "language": null,
    "rating": 1,
    "title": "Unauthorized charge",
    "text": "Canceled my plan two months in a row and I’ve gotten billed two months in a row. This is fraud and will be reporting to the FTC",
    "date": "2026-11-08T16:40:42.000Z",
    "appVersion": "26.4.0",
    "developerReply": null
  }
]
```

API call:
```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/cleanyield~app-store-google-play-reviews/run-sync-get-dataset-items?maxTotalChargeUsd=1" -H "Authorization: Bearer $APIFY_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"apps":["https://apps.apple.com/us/app/netflix/id363590051"],"countries":["us"],"maxRating":2,"maxReviewsPerApp":30}'
```

Use-case pages: https://cleanyield-data.github.io/app-store-reviews-api/, https://cleanyield-data.github.io/google-play-reviews-scraper/

## Latin America Public Tenders

Store page: https://apify.com/cleanyield/latam-public-tenders
Try the Lite version first (no per-result charge): https://apify.com/cleanyield/latam-public-tenders-lite
API actor ID: cleanyield/latam-public-tenders

Returns public tenders from Colombia (SECOP), Brazil (PNCP), Chile (Mercado Público) and Paraguay (DNCP) in one format, with an English title, the amount in USD when the tender states one, the buyer and the bid deadline.

Input: countries, sectors or keywords, status; optional publishedWithinDays, minAmountUsd, buyers, tenderIds.

Output (one row per tender):
- tenderId, country, source, url: the tender and a link to the official notice
- title, titleEn, description: original title and an English translation
- buyer: buying agency with city and region
- amount (value, currency, valueUsd): estimated amount in local currency and USD, when the tender states one
- status, procedureType: open, closed or awarded, and the type of procedure
- publishedDate, closingDate: publication date and bid deadline
- awardees: winner and awarded amount, if awarded

Price today: USD 8 per 1,000 tenders (USD 0.008 per tender) on the Apify Free plan; Apify subscribers pay less (Gold: USD 6.20 per 1,000).
Optional Pro mode: + USD 0.006 per tender (fit score, urgency, buyer profile). Tender IDs that do not exist and incomplete records are not charged.
Lite version: no per-result charge, up to 25 tenders per run (only Apify platform usage applies).

Real example (run on Apify on 2026-11-09, 15 results; 15 open IT and software tenders: 7 from Colombia, 5 from Brazil and 3 from Chile; 13 of the 15 state an amount.)

Input:
```json
{
  "countries": [
    "CO",
    "BR",
    "CL"
  ],
  "sectors": [
    "it-software"
  ],
  "status": [
    "open"
  ],
  "publishedWithinDays": 5,
  "maxResults": 15
}
```

Output (selected fields):

## Direct answers

### How to get job postings from the Greenhouse API

https://cleanyield-data.github.io/greenhouse-job-board-api/

Greenhouse publishes every company’s open jobs in a free Job Board API that needs no key: GET https://boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/{board_token}/jobs?content=true. For one company that is enough; for many companies, salaries as a yearly range and the same format as Lever, Workday and 16 other hiring systems, use Clean Yield’s ATS Jobs Scraper.

Doing it yourself: One company, from the command line. The board token is the last part of job-boards.greenhouse.io/<token>; careers pages that embed Greenhouse show it as boards.greenhouse.io/embed/job_board?for=<token>.
```
curl "https://boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/airbnb/jobs?content=true&pay_transparency=true"
```
- One board per request, and you need the exact board token.
- Pay ranges come only with pay_transparency=true and only when the company enables them, in cents and sometimes repeated per region.
- Location is free text: there is no remote, hybrid or onsite field.
- Lever, Ashby, Workday and the rest each have a different format.

### How to get job postings from Workday

https://cleanyield-data.github.io/workday-jobs-api/

Workday has no documented public jobs API, but every myworkdayjobs.com careers site loads its list from a public JSON endpoint: POST https://{tenant}.wdN.myworkdayjobs.com/wday/cxs/{tenant}/{site}/jobs, 20 jobs per page. To skip the paging, the relative dates and one extra request per job, paste the careers site URL into Clean Yield’s ATS Jobs Scraper and get clean rows with exact posting dates.

Doing it yourself: The tenant, the wdN host and the site name are all in the careers site URL (here nvidia, wd5 and NVIDIAExternalCareerSite).
```
curl -X POST "https://nvidia.wd5.myworkdayjobs.com/wday/cxs/nvidia/NVIDIAExternalCareerSite/jobs" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"appliedFacets":{},"limit":20,"offset":0,"searchText":""}'
```
- At most 20 jobs per request, so large employers need many pages.
- The list gives "Posted Today" or "Posted 30+ Days Ago", not a date; the date and description need one more request per job.
- Undocumented: Workday can change it, and some tenants ask robots in robots.txt to stay out.

### How to get job postings from the Lever API

https://cleanyield-data.github.io/lever-postings-api/

Lever’s public Postings API returns a company’s published jobs with no key: GET https://api.lever.co/v0/postings/{company}?mode=json (EU-hosted boards use api.eu.lever.co). Clean Yield’s ATS Jobs Scraper reads the same feed for many companies at once, at the 1 request per second Lever asks for, and returns the salary when stated in the same format as Greenhouse and Workday.

Doing it yourself: The company slug is the part after jobs.lever.co/.
```
curl "https://api.lever.co/v0/postings/spotify?mode=json"
```
- One company per request, and the slug must be exact (EU boards answer on a different host).
- Salary appears only when the company fills Lever’s salary range; ranges in the description are not parsed.
- Dates are Unix milliseconds and the format differs from every other ATS.

### How to look up an FMCSA carrier by MC number

https://cleanyield-data.github.io/fmcsa-mc-number-lookup-api/

For one carrier, search the MC number in FMCSA’s SAFER Company Snapshot (search by MC/MX number). For a list, or from code, Clean Yield’s FMCSA Carrier Lookup takes MC numbers and returns the USDOT number, legal name, authority status per docket, insurance on file and fleet size from FMCSA’s official data, re-checking statuses live on SAFER when the open data may be out of date.

Doing it yourself: One carrier, no key needed (the same page you see in a browser):
```
https://safer.fmcsa.dot.gov/query.asp?searchtype=ANY&query_type=queryCarrierSnapshot&query_param=MC_MX&query_string=135797
```
- One carrier per page, in HTML: fine to check a carrier, slow for a list.
- FMCSA’s open data (data.transportation.gov) is free, but the Company Census holds only three dockets per carrier: J.B. Hunt’s MC-135797 is not in its census row (checked 2026-11-11), so you also need the Motus authority dataset.
- Insurance, authority, census and inspections are separate datasets you have to join yourself.

### How to get public tenders from Colombia and Chile by API

https://cleanyield-data.github.io/colombia-chile-public-tenders-api/

Colombia publishes its tenders as open data on datos.gov.co (SECOP II) and Chile through Mercado Público’s open OCDS API; both are free, but fields, currencies and status names differ. Clean Yield’s Latin America Public Tenders returns both, plus Brazil, Paraguay and Uruguay (beta), in one format with the bid deadline, the amount in USD when the tender states one and a link to the official notice.

Doing it yourself: Colombia (SECOP II processes, Socrata API) and Chile (OCDS list of the month), no registration:
```
curl -G "https://www.datos.gov.co/resource/p6dx-8zbt.json" \
  --data-urlencode "\$where=estado_del_procedimiento='Publicado' AND fecha_de_publicacion_del >= '2026-11-09T00:00:00'" \
  --data-urlencode "\$limit=50"
curl "https://apis.mercadopublico.cl/OCDS/data/listaA%C3%B1oMes/2026/11/0/100"
```
- SECOP’s status column alone misleads: processes in "Evaluación" or "Aprobado" can still be open until their deadline, and direct contracts are mixed in.
- Chile’s list returns only codes; each tender needs another request, and the open data can lag the portal by a few hours.
- Amounts come in COP or CLP, with different field names in each country.

### ¿Cómo obtener por API las licitaciones abiertas de Colombia (SECOP II)?

https://cleanyield-data.github.io/licitaciones-colombia-secop-api/

SECOP II publica sus procesos como datos abiertos en datos.gov.co (dataset p6dx-8zbt, API Socrata), gratis y sin registro. Si quieres solo las abiertas de verdad, con fecha de cierre, monto en pesos y en dólares y el link al aviso, en un formato listo para usar, la Licitaciones Públicas de Latinoamérica de Clean Yield lo hace en una corrida de segundos.

Doing it yourself: Procesos publicados desde el 9/11, directo de la API de datos abiertos:
```
curl -G "https://www.datos.gov.co/resource/p6dx-8zbt.json" \
  --data-urlencode "\$where=estado_del_procedimiento='Publicado' AND fecha_de_publicacion_del >= '2026-11-09T00:00:00'" \
  --data-urlencode "\$limit=50"
```
- El estado solo engaña: hay procesos en "Evaluación" o "Aprobado" que siguen recibiendo ofertas hasta su fecha de cierre, y otros "Publicado" que ya cerraron.
- Vienen mezcladas la contratación directa y los regímenes especiales, que no son licitaciones abiertas a cualquiera.
- El monto viene como texto en pesos y el link al aviso, anidado.

### ¿Cómo obtener las licitaciones de Mercado Público (Chile) por API sin ticket?

https://cleanyield-data.github.io/licitaciones-chile-mercado-publico-api/

La API clásica de Mercado Público pide un ticket, pero ChileCompra también publica las licitaciones en su API OCDS abierta (apis.mercadopublico.cl/OCDS), sin registro. La Licitaciones Públicas de Latinoamérica de Clean Yield la lee por ti y devuelve cada licitación con comprador y RUT, región, fecha de cierre y monto en pesos y en dólares cuando se informa.

Doing it yourself: Lista de licitaciones del mes (códigos) y después el detalle de cada una:
```
curl "https://apis.mercadopublico.cl/OCDS/data/listaA%C3%B1oMes/2026/11/0/100"
curl "https://apis.mercadopublico.cl/OCDS/data/tender/2318-86-LE26"
```
- La lista solo trae códigos: cada licitación es una consulta más (el 11/11 había más de 3.300 en el mes).
- Los datos abiertos pueden ir unas horas atrás del portal.
- Formato OCDS: el monto, las fechas y el comprador están en partes distintas del documento.
